annotations.title: Edit or delete a LinkedIn post

description: Edit or delete a published LinkedIn post — personal profile or company Page. Pass postUrn, the full urn returned when it was published. action:"edit" changes ONLY THE COPY: LinkedIn does not allow the image or video of a published post to be replaced, so a new visual means a NEW post — tell the user that instead of promising a swap. action:"delete" is immediate and public and requires confirm:true.

action.description: edit changes the copy only; delete removes the post and needs confirm

brand.description: WHICH PROFILE the post lives in — id or exact name from list_brands (a shared workspace: its profile id). Needed when it was published in a profile this connection is not pinned to; applies to THIS CALL ONLY. A name that matches no profile, or two, is REFUSED and nothing is done.

postUrn.description: the full LinkedIn post urn returned by publishing
